The '''IR-52 Airborne Assault Droid''' was a model of bipedal [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]], a freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. The IR-52 was designed for aerial combat environments, and had built-in rockets.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
IR-52 Airborne Assault Droids appear as enemies in the missions "Dark Design" and "All the Pieces," which are the Republic and Imperial versions of a mission in the [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] mission in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
